integrity: Mathematical proof reviewed in the same-model review and deterministic exact-rational checker replayed. Literature priority is provisional, with inaccessible complete 2006 primary source; independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional independence and exponentially declining false-positive probabilities at sites without live occupancy are imposed assumptions. Known true-detection probability greater than initial false-detection is required. Only the q=1 known-perfect-detection limit admits the claimed optimal revisit formula; no general-q optimal timing, field calibration, finite-sample behavior, or costs of waiting are claimed.
title: Two visits identify residual-marker decay and have a unique optimal revisit gap
